title: Semi-supervised Sequence Learning
before: Sequence models were trained from scratch on each labelled task.
problem: Labelled data is scarce; unlabelled text is not.
breakthrough: Pretrain a recurrent model as a language model or autoencoder, then fine-tune it on the target task.
why: The pretrain-then-fine-tune recipe in its original form. GPT-1 and BERT both cite it.
next: ULMFiT, ELMo, GPT-1 and BERT built directly on this template.
inherits: The two-stage training that defines modern LLM development.
